reliability_gate.predeclared_criteria: Both models: >=2 fixed and >=2 fresh blind synthetic cases; all calls completed; 100% RAW rubric PASS and cross-field consistency. Replayed blind calls are not fresh.
reliability_gate.scope: Small synthetic screen; no statistical, legal or real-customer validation
reliability_gate.next_action: Human reviews original RAW diagnosis and code-vs-contract evidence. Retry only incomplete calls with saved model/input; do not overwrite completed failures.

diagnostic_axes.limitations: Pass means an individual criterion passed in small synthetic fixtures. Lexical cross-field checks are not proof of semantic truth. Blind replays are not fresh trials; no causal or legal conclusions.

targeted_repair_summary.note: Only input-observable contradictions trigger opt-in repair; repair is not proof of correct interpretation. Blind never receives feedback.
